recommendation_1: Reduce mid_dim from 100 to 32 in the Net class constructor.
rationale_1: Drastically decreases the number of trainable parameters in fc1 and fc, reducing the memory footprint and energy consumption during gradient computation.
recommendation_3: Apply Bfloat16 Autocast using torch.amp.autocast during the training and inference loops on the CPU.
rationale_3: Lowers memory bandwidth requirements and reduces the energy per floating-point operation compared to FP32.
recommendation_4: Apply L1 Unstructured Pruning to the fc1 layer with amount=0.4, followed immediately by prune.remove.
rationale_4: Eliminates 40% of redundant weights in the largest layer to reduce the state_dict size transmitted between the Flower client and server.
recommendation_5: Apply L1 Unstructured Pruning to the fc layer with amount=0.2, followed immediately by prune.remove.
rationale_5: Further minimizes the model size and reduces the computational energy required for the final linear transformation.
